purpose: Current production-readiness evidence boundaries for Weapp Container

entries.scope: Pinned weapp-vite aggregate build matrix for weapp, alipay, swan, tt, jd and xhs
entries.conclusion: All six pinned platform build targets passed with current runner provenance
entries.limitations: Build success does not establish official WeChat DevTools conformance, native GPU behavior, V8 availability, host bridge coverage or production signing

entries.scope: Android emulator emulator-5554 using the submitted debug QuickJS APK and the source-bound portable pack
entries.conclusion: Passed app installation, app.init, render.commit, QuickJS module probes, RGBA snapshot, Canvas/API probes and an attached Skia GLES surface with nativeSurface=true
entries.limitations: This is emulator evidence for the QuickJS debug APK. It does not certify a signed release APK, Android V8, physical devices, other mobile hosts or official WeChat behavior

entries.scope: Android release APK installation on emulator-5554
entries.conclusion: The locally built unsigned APK was rejected with INSTALL_PARSE_FAILED_NO_CERTIFICATES; after zipalign and v2/v3 signing with the machine Android Debug certificate, the resulting APK installed successfully on emulator-5554
entries.limitations: The debug certificate is not production signing material. A production certificate, release policy verification and signed release runtime acceptance are still required

entries.tool: Rust native build and pinned V8 dependency inspection
entries.scope: Android V8 provider and static-library inputs
entries.conclusion: Blocked because the pinned V8 release assets do not provide Android bindings or a matching static library, while the source-build dependency chain was unavailable in the current network environment
entries.limitations: No Android V8 runtime result is claimed and the pinned V8 version was not changed without upstream-compatible evidence
